title: radimagenet_open as a 4th open-text cell -- OUT-OF-DOMAIN transfer of the frozen head

cleanliness.note: reserved as a train source in verifier_disjoint_split.json and never spent; the frozen head has never seen a radimagenet image or question.

caveats: JUDGE ONLY. Exact match is not reported: radimagenet golds are terse anatomy/pathology labels and EM would be dominated by surface form. The judge was audited -- of the 1,422 answers it marks wrong for the 32B, only 3 contain the gold string -- so the low 32B score is not a formatting artifact.

Picks are over DISTINCT normalised answers, not the 8 raw slots. Duplicates share a feature vector and a label, so the picked ANSWER is the same either way; only the tie-break differs from the 8-slot convention used on the frozen three cells.
The head is applied with its FROZEN train standardiser (mu/sd fitted on the four in-domain sets). No refit, no recalibration on radimagenet.

VERDICT.one_line: THE FROZEN HEAD DOES NOT TRANSFER TO THIS CELL. Against always-7B greedy it is +0.0065 [-0.0090,+0.0220], a TIE. Its selection efficiency is 0.6396 against a random-pick floor of 0.5823 on the same pool -- it captures 13.7% of the headroom above chance, where on the three in-domain cells it captures ~39%.
VERDICT.the_win_over_32b_is_not_the_head: 7B+head beats Lingshu-32B direct by +0.0385 [+0.0190,+0.0570], but always-7B greedy ALONE already beats it by +0.0320 [+0.0135,+0.0500]. The margin is the 7B being better than the 32B on this cell, not the selector doing work.
VERDICT.what_it_implies: The head is not a general-purpose verifier -- it is fitted to the domains in its training pool (pathvqa 71%, kvasir 18%, slake 7%, vqa_rad 4%). Every new eval cell therefore needs a matching TRAIN split, not just eval data. That changes the expansion plan from 'add cells' to 'add train+eval pairs'.
VERDICT.scope: ONE cell, and an unusual one: terse anatomy/pathology labels on which Lingshu-32B itself scores only 0.2890. Do not generalise to 'the head never transfers' from a single out-of-domain measurement.
VERDICT.next_test: leave-one-dataset-out CV inside the existing training pool measures the same thing on four datasets at zero GPU cost.
